LL black realized all-pass need not emerge even when black goal rate is high; distinguish goal attainment from exact trajectory and report competing long-route behavior.

Existing colour+agent seed RNG derivation unchanged. Budget-specific trajectories diverge and are paired, not independent.

statistics.estimand: For each identity direction, pooled mean equally weights the six fixed batch-seed by agent-orientation strata; per-seed mean equally weights two orientations. Independent pseudorandom stream replication model, arbitrary within-block budget dependence and unequal stratum probabilities; no population-of-agents or deterministic-seed uncertainty claim.
statistics.paired_difference: D_i=Y_comparison,i-Y_baseline,i. Nplus counts D=1; Nminus counts D=-1. Estimate=(Nplus-Nminus)/n; preserve n00,n01,n10,n11 and denominator n=60 pooled or20perseed.
statistics.paired_marginal_interval: Compute97.5% equal-tail TWO-SIDED Clopper-Pearson intervals[Lplus,Uplus],[Lminus,Uminus] for Nplus/n and Nminus/n. Report conservative95% interval[Lplus-Uminus,Uplus-Lminus], constrained[-1,1]. By Mattner-Tasto heterogeneous-average theorem and union bound, at least nominal coverage under independent blocks; no independence between discordant counts needed.
statistics.marginal_rates: Two-sided95% Clopper-Pearson intervals for average success probability of independent nonidentical Bernoullis; counts and denominators always included.
statistics.simultaneous_family: Exactly six POOLED primary intervals: three route endpoints times256-64 and1024-64. Bonferroni alpha=.05/6 per interval; each component CP confidence1-.05/12. Label separately. All per-seed,per-stratum,secondary and other endpoint95% intervals are marginal and not family-adjusted.
statistics.audit_interval: Hoeffding for paired differences[-1,1]: estimate +/-sqrt(2log(2/.05)/n), constrained[-1,1]. An independent conservative audit, never intersected data-dependently with the CP rectangle.
statistics.boundary_examples: All-concordant n60 produces paired95% interval approximately[-.0704305688,.0704305688], not[0,0]. All-concordant n20 remains wider. Zeroevent marginal0/60 upper=1-.025^(1/60)approximately.0596.
statistics.length_and_mechanism: All budget contrasts include matched length differences and distribution descriptive summaries. Mixed-minus-same means equally weight two identity directions on each side and report each seed plus pooled; exclusion of all2-3ply games is a conditional descriptive sensitivity with denominators, not causal evidence. No length hypothesis tests or unplanned confidence intervals.
statistics.no_inference_gate: No p-values, significance flags, efficacy decision thresholds, optional stopping or outcome-dependent growth. Finish fixed720valid registered games or explicit incomplete safety pause. All pilot72games excluded.
statistics.theorem: Mattner and Tasto2015,published Theorem1.3/arXivv3Theorem1.12: two-sided equal-tail CP confidence at least.5 is valid for average of independent heterogeneous Bernoulli probabilities. One-sided CP robustness is not asserted.

expansion_rule: None. Exactly720 valid registered games,72 cost-pilot games excluded. No optional stopping, significance target, selected-cell extension or automatic growth to1800. Incomplete safety stop reported as incomplete.

resource_policy.retry_policy: Preserve every valid completed game. Safe interruption/network retries and slowdown allowed, check remote state before retrying uncertain writes. Two failed recovery attempts for the same diagnosed persistent fault trigger checkpoint, backup where possible, and pause. No seed replacement or outcome-based retry.
resource_policy.github_sync: After each fixed24-game boundary, full read-only validation then GitHub checkpoint. Single game worker; stop at each boundary until backup verified. Large files uploaded separately as blobs; no force push. A sync fault does not count as a game failure.
